def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Find seed color and its 3x3 tile address.  Color the same 2x2 motif
    # wherever that motif is present, preserving all 0/background cells.
    marks=[(r,c,v) for r in range(h) for c,v in enumerate(g[r]) if v not in (0,1)]
    for r,c,v in marks:
        # marker-based motif in examples is a 2x2 region at a fixed location in
        # an underlying repeated, 3-cell-spaced array of patterns.
        # The local pattern color is applied according to the seed's offset.
        for rr in range(h-1):
            for cc in range(w-1):
                if (rr-r)%3==0 and (cc-c)%3==0 and all(grid[y][x]==1 for y in range(rr,rr+2) for x in range(cc,cc+2)):
                    for y in range(rr,rr+2):
                        for x in range(cc,cc+2): g[y][x]=v
        g[r][c]=v
    return g
